* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

All.
Including
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAP14E8.04 Oma1

Oma1 and orthologs are involved in protein quality control, not processing.

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**


Missannotation. These papers describe quality control
mouse
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24550258/
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24719224/
human
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25275009/



* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
